cycles.method: An event is one composed screen frame while the CREATE BEAT GRID popup is open: module_draw combines the cached popup with the stock home frame, on the UI task, not in an interrupt. Measured on the author's MKII, 20 Nov 2026, agent's run, a development twin of base 0.7.11 with SNAP (54cab594, RAM boot) and package 195d2b46: modwerk_cost[22] (runtime module draw, DTIM3 counts at 132 MHz) read before and after about 10 s with the popup open and its settings turned 16 times: 198.1 us a tick over 695 UI ticks, 52,298 cycles at 264 MHz (0.1.66: 1,058 us). Popup closed: 6.3 us a tick over 604 ticks. An average, not a per-frame maximum; the popup is cached until its data changes, so frames after a turn cost more than idle ones. No static bound was counted. SNAP analysis runs in the base's engine task, not in the module, and is measured separately (TESTING.md). Budget: one UI tick, 16.4 ms at 61 ticks a second (4,330,000 cycles).

load.method: Hardware, not cfmeter.py, on the author's MKII (twin 54cab594), transport stopped on the AED SLICE page of a Static sample, Beat Slicer installed as a trial. Longest frame from the base's guard: 36.2 % (131.3 us) with the popup closed, 36.5 % (132.4 us) with it open and its settings turning. CPU meter, six readings each: 394-396 per mille closed, 401-403 open, so idle 60.4 % and 59.8 %; the difference matches the draw hook's 198 us in each 16.4 ms tick (1.2 %). The cost applies only while the popup is open. With the pattern playing and a SNAP ON replace analysing, the guard's longest frame stayed at 38 % with no frame skipped (TESTING.md). No MIDI flood ran.

stress.method: On the author's MKII (twin 54cab594), T1 Static sample, bank H Part 1, Beat Slicer 0.1.68 installed as a timed trial: the dearest event, opening CREATE BEAT GRID (FUNC+AED twice, the popup drawn) and closing it with NO, pressed 20 times while the pattern played, in two batches of 10 with STOP, PLAY and a Part change to Part 2 and back between them. A screenshot in each batch showed the popup; it answered every time. Health afterwards: loader stalls and errors 0, no new crash or stall record, the guard's longest frame 63.1 % with nothing skipped. SNAP replaces while playing were run separately (TESTING.md).
